capture_contract.task_contract: task contract and candidate identifiers/path mapping
capture_contract.soft_state: Progress is { pass: number, notes: Neuralese<string> } carried by iterateOn
capture_contract.iteration: four passes: notice; per-candidate scores plus comparison; per-candidate eligibility plus reconciliation; authorization
capture_contract.candidate_lambdas: each candidate reader receives exactly one candidate-specific FileHandle and candidateId, returns a typed fact object
capture_contract.reconciliation: separate typed child combines the current batch with prior notes after each array of candidate readers
capture_contract.final_interpreter: typed Draft interpreter applies the unchanged decision rule to accumulated facts

generation.source_quality: Data-derived instance in existing train group v17:clinic_cold_chain_release:scenario-2; two explicit conjunctive criteria, one high-scoring single-criterion failure per negative type, and two eligible candidates tied on score. No independent-world credit.
generation.soft_state_reference: Authored reference exercises typed Neuralese writer-to-argument-to-reader edges; scripted evidence is not teacher observation or semantic truth.
generation.authored_root_context: project-authored source-bound root action; task prompt does not include the reference source
